name: Lily
overview: In the Gospel accounts of Matthew and Luke, Jesus uses the example of lilies in the field to illustrate God's providential care and the beauty He imparts to His creation. The lilies, though they neither toil nor spin, are adorned with a glory surpassing even that of Solomon, emphasizing the sufficiency of God's provision. This imagery encourages believers to trust in God's faithful care, knowing that if He so clothes the transient grass of the field, He will surely clothe and care for His people, who sometimes struggle with little faith.
